mappings.name: A new delivery address for PX-5102

output.text:
Hello, yes: you can change the delivery address of PX-5102 until it is out for delivery. Open its tracking page, choose Change delivery and enter your new address.

Kind regards, the Parcels support team

Hello Ms Weber, we are sorry that PX-5101 has not reached you. Please check with your neighbours first: the courier's photo of the delivery is on its tracking page. If you still cannot find it, reply to this message and we will open an investigation with the courier.

Kind regards, the Parcels support team

Hello, we are sorry your parcel arrived damaged. Please keep it and everything that came in it, and send us a photo of it from its tracking page: the shop that sent it files the claim with us.

Kind regards, the Parcels support team
